steps.clue: Activate the Staging Area teleporter and escape the accelerating rounds.
Collect four parts in Anytown and repair the Fuel Processing teleporter.
Defeat the Abomination, enter the Observation Tower and unlock Pack-a-Punch.
Press the hidden red button in the Observation Tower to reveal the Forsaken.
Use the Chrysalax to destroy three giant Aetherium Crystals and collect their Crystal Shards.
Feed the Crystal Shards to Abominations, kill them and collect the Catalyzed Crystal Shards.
Build the Aetherium Neutralizer with its three parts and three Catalyzed Crystal Shards.
Escort the Neutralizer down Main Street, refuelling it with orange crystal shards.
Charge Maxis’s laser cannons and strike the Forsaken’s exposed weak points to defeat him.
